## Lab Life

```{=html}
<!-- To add a photo, add a figure below, oldest first. The buttons and timing need no change. -->
<div class="lab-life-show" role="group" aria-label="Lab Life photos">
<div class="lab-life-slides">
<figure class="is-current">
<img src="members/images/lab_oct2025_web.jpg" alt="Lab evening out">
<figcaption>Oct 2025</figcaption>
</figure>
<figure>
<img src="members/images/lab_jun2026_web.jpg" alt="Lab group photo">
<figcaption>June 2026</figcaption>
</figure>
<figure>
<img src="members/images/lab_oct2026.jpg" alt="Lab dinner, October 2026">
<figcaption>Oct 2026</figcaption>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="lab-life-nav">
<button type="button" class="lab-life-prev" aria-label="Previous photo"><i class="bi bi-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button type="button" class="lab-life-pause" aria-label="Pause photos"><i class="bi bi-pause-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button type="button" class="lab-life-next" aria-label="Next photo"><i class="bi bi-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</div>
</div>

<script>
// Lab Life: a new photo every 5 seconds until someone presses pause. It starts
// paused for people who ask for reduced motion.
(function () {
  var show = document.querySelector(".lab-life-show");
  var slides = show.querySelectorAll("figure");
  var pauseButton = show.querySelector(".lab-life-pause");
  var pauseIcon = pauseButton.querySelector("i");
  var current = 0;
  var paused = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var timer;

  function move(step) {
    slides[current].classList.remove("is-current");
    current = (current + step + slides.length) % slides.length;
    slides[current].classList.add("is-current");
  }

  function restartTimer() {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = setInterval(function () {
      if (!paused) move(1);
    }, 5000);
  }

  function showPauseState() {
    pauseButton.setAttribute("aria-label", paused ? "Play photos" : "Pause photos");
    pauseIcon.className = paused ? "bi bi-play-fill" : "bi bi-pause-fill";
  }

  show.querySelector(".lab-life-prev").addEventListener("click", function () { move(-1); restartTimer(); });
  show.querySelector(".lab-life-next").addEventListener("click", function () { move(1); restartTimer(); });
  pauseButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
    paused = !paused;
    showPauseState();
    restartTimer();
  });

  showPauseState();
  restartTimer();
})();
</script>
```
